title: Reporting Phishing Emails & Suspicious Links to IT Security
workplace_track: Cybersecurity, Endpoint Protection & Zero Trust Architecture
description: Foundational IT workplace English module covering reporting phishing emails & suspicious links to it security.
learning_objectives: Master professional Past Simple Negatives & Modals in enterprise IT infrastructure and cloud operations
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in reporting phishing emails & suspicious links to it security
Demonstrate precision in Zero Trust architecture, ITIL incident management, and cyber governance

questions.prompt: Yesterday during the network maintenance window, the service desk technician _____ the user's Active Directory password via the IT support portal.

explanations.correct: Specific completed past time 'Yesterday' strictly requires Past Simple 'reset'.
explanations.wrong_A: Base form 'reset' lacks past tense marking.
explanations.wrong_C: Present Perfect 'has reset' cannot co-occur with 'yesterday'.
explanations.wrong_D: Present Continuous describes current actions, not yesterday's finished events.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech uses the same past tense, but in English, 'yesterday' strictly triggers Past Simple ('reset').
